Standards compliance: unique content, no template text
Quality fixes: removed third-party references, aligned docs with implementation

Initial release of Pitch Deck Creator.

- Generate pitch decks with slide structure, storytelling, investor Q&A, demo day preparation, and feedback refinement.
- Designed for Chinese-language users with focus on local market and cultural understanding.
- Multiple commands support various use cases, including create, slide, story, investor, demo, and feedback.
- Outputs practical, ready-to-use content for fundraising, roadshows, and presentations.
